decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: FlowInfo and Funcdata share one mutable Override/PcodeOpBank/qlst state. overrideFlow mutates the selected primary PcodeOp in place, preserving object identity and SeqNum, and allocates one RETURN after it. Ghidra FuncCallSpecs::op is a shared PcodeOp pointer; Rugra's Weak link upgrades to the exact Arc allocation and is compared by Arc::ptr_eq after the spec guard is released. Ghidra fixture Addresses carry the default RAM AddrSpace, while Rugra Address::new carries a null base; this input/state difference is also printed and retained.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: FlowInfo caches hasFlowOverride at construction, queries the exact instruction address before lift, applies overrideFlow after lift and before xref, and xref walks the new dead-list suffix in insertion order. findPrimaryBranch walks beginOp(addr)..endOp(addr) in SeqNum order. The standalone subset scans sorted half-open ELF bodies and iced instruction boundaries, accepting only direct unconditional near jumps to known entries.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: insn_count increments once per processInstruction after the maximum check; the dead-list boundary is captured before lift. CALL_RETURN's new RETURN receives the next immutable per-address time, is moved directly after the primary op, and has a one-byte constant zero input. Producer records are accumulated once per owner then globally deduplicated by (function_entry, instruction_address).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: Native op selection is PcodeOpTree SeqNum (address,time) order and dead-list order is not sorted for comparison. Standalone functions and output records use numeric (entry,address) BTree ordering; same-entry aliases must have the same extent and overlapping bodies fail visibly. Exact callspec identity matches without normalization; the retained raw diff contains only RAM-space versus null-space case headers.
